title: A menu that says Custom lets you get back to Custom
goal: Drag a turning layer's pivot somewhere of your own and the Around menu says Custom. Open that menu to see what Top centre would look like, pick it, and there is no way back: Custom is a word the menu prints but will not let you choose, so your own point is gone unless you drag the crosshair again or type the numbers back in by hand. A menu that shows a value should let you pick it, or should say why it cannot.
notes: Found by the daily digest of 2026-09-20 in the rough list of queue/audits/2026-09-20-motion-pivot-reads-once.json, which shipped the Around row saying Custom: 'Custom is a word the menu shows but does not offer: once you pick a named spot there is no way back to your own point except by dragging the crosshair again or typing into At. That is true of every menu with a custom value in it.' The same audit names New Frame and New Canvas as already printing Custom for a size that is not a preset. Nothing in the queue covered it: searched 'menu shows Custom but does not offer it' and 'custom value in a menu cannot be chosen', both empty. The likely shape of the answer is that picking Custom means 'put back the last value I set by hand', which means the row has to remember it, so check whether the pivot already keeps that when a named spot is picked.
acceptance: Opening the Around menu after dragging a pivot, picking a named spot, then reopening it, gets your own point back in one step
The same is true of every menu in the app that prints a value it worked out rather than one you chose: New Frame's size menu and New Canvas's are the other two known cases and each is checked
Whatever the answer is, it is one answer used in all three places rather than three local fixes
If the answer is that a computed value can never be re-picked, the menu says so plainly instead of printing a choice that does nothing
A walk covers the pivot case: drag the crosshair, pick a named spot, get your own point back, and read the row
Audit under queue/audits/ showing the round trip, and anything rough filed as a follow-up

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: the Around menu offered three named spots and printed Custom without offering it; New Frame/Canvas/Video had a Custom row that showed the PRESET's numbers after you tried a preset, so the typed size was lost the same way; both Curve menus (Motion 'Drawn', Properties 'Custom') lose a drawn curve the same way. One answer for all six: PhotonzCore CustomChoice keeps the last value of your own a menu moved away from, and Custom puts it back. Pivot and Motion curve memory is saved with the document (LayerMotion.ownPivot/ownCurve, kept via keepingOwnValues in EditorState.updateMotion, so every door counts); Properties stretch curves remember per window (EditorState.ownStretchCurves); dialogs keep it in @State and show the kept size beside Custom. Mock (icon-animate-wt.html #oriMenu) ends with 'Somewhere else… Y', which the app never had: filed p1 the-around-menu-ends-with-somewhere-else-as-the. Verified: CustomChoiceTests (12), full suite 10996 green, custom-goes-back-walk ok at Next defaults (pivot round trip from file and from a drag; New Frame, New Canvas, New Video round trips), and 9 neighbour walks ok. Left rough (no task): the two Curve menus have no walk because no walk step draws a curve. Also found the 'switched-off motion' render test failure is a stale incremental build, filed a-change-to-a-core-type-rebuilds-every-test-that.

Custom is now a real choice in every menu that prints it: Around (turn pivot), Motion's Curve (Drawn), Properties' Curve (Custom), and the Custom row of New Frame, New Canvas and New Video. One shared answer, PhotonzCore CustomChoice: the menu keeps the last value of your own and Custom puts it back. Verified with CustomChoiceTests, full suite 10996 green, and custom-goes-back-walk at Next defaults (pivot from a file and from a drag, plus all three size dialogs). Audit queue/audits/2026-10-02-custom-goes-back.json. Commit e78347ac.
